consequencesIfNotApproved: Errors remain in the specification.
reasonForChange:
The MB-SMF related “transfer” IEs are defined as OCTET STRING in the tabular but not in the ASN.1, which means the MB-SMF containers are not transparent to the AMF as intended.
In alignment with principles established when introducing SMF “transfer” IEs in Rel-15, the MB-SMF “transfer” IEs:
should be named according to the NGAP message that carries it;
should include criticality information if (and only if) carried in an NGAP “request” message terminating at the NG-RAN node.
IEs that are reused in the asn.1 should also be reused in the tabular by creating a “factorized” IE (e.g. MBS QoS Flows To Be Setup List)
Lists that contain a sequence in the ASN.1 (i.e. an “Item” level) should also have an “Item” level in the tabular to clearly show that the list is extensible.
IE names should follow NGAP conventions.
Mismatches between ASN.1 and tabular.
Miscellaneous ASN.1 errors.
summaryOfChange:
General: tabular is aligned with ASN.1 where needed, e.g. “Item” level added in Lists.
9.2.16.3: Assigned Criticality for MBS Session Setup Failure Transfer IE is changed to “ignore”.
9.2.16.6: Assigned Criticality for MBS Session Modification Failure Transfer IE is changed to “ignore”.
9.3.1.x: The MBS QoS Flows To Be Setup List IE is introduced since it is reused in 4 places in the ASN.1.
9.3.5.1: IEs renamed to avoid misuse of the words “Item” and “Transfer” in IE names.
9.3.5.2: The MBS Session TNL Information 5GC Item IE is renamed (since names ending in Item are reserved for an item in a list). The new name is “Shared NG-U Multicast TNL Information IE” to align with its usage elsewhere (e.g. in the MBS Distribution Setup Response Transfer IE in 9.3.5.8). The IE description is modified due to the renaming of the IE.
9.3.5.3, 9.3.5.5, 9.3.5.6: The MB-SMF related “transfer” IEs are renamed to match the NGAP messages that carry them. For these 3 IEs, they are reused over NGAP in both Setup and Modification messages.
9.3.5.5, 9.3.5.6, 9.3.5.8: Criticality columns are removed since these “transfer” IEs are not carried in an NGAP “request” message terminating at the NG-RAN node.
9.3.5.6: The Criticality Diagnostics IE added.
9.3.5.13: Criticality columns are added since the Multicast Session Update Request Transfer IE is carred in an NGAP “request” message terminating at the NG-RAN node.
Procedural text: IEs renamed in the procedural text to align with the renaming of IEs in the ASN.1/tabular (see items 3-5).
9.4.4, 9.4.5, 9.4.7 (ASN.1):
Corresponding ASN.1 impacts of items 1-10 above.
Encoding of MB-SMF IEs changed to “OCTET STRING (CONTAINING xxxTransfer)”
MBS-QoSFlows-ToBeSetupModList is removed. It was used only in the Multicast Session Update Request Transfer IE (while  MBS-QoSFlows-ToBeSetupList is used in the MBS Session Setup or Modification Request Transfer IE). Presumably the same list should be used in both IEs, so it is harmonzed to use MBS-QoSFlows-ToBeSetupList.
The MBS Area Session ID was missing from the ASN.1 of the location dependent MBS Service Area, so a new SEQUENCE (MBS-ServiceAreaInformationItem) was added.
The MBS Area Session ID was missing from the ASN.1 of the location dependent MBS Session TNL Information NG-RAN, so a new SEQUENCE (MBS-SessionTNLInfoNGRANItem) was added.
The ASN.1 encoding of the location independent MBS Session TNL Information NG-RAN required correction due to subtleties of a CHOICE containing only a single optional IE. A new SEQUENCE (MBS-SessionTNLInfoNGRANSingle) was added.
The ASN.1 encoding of Multicast Group Paging Area required correction since it did not match the tabular.
In BroadcastSessionModificationFailure, the MBSSessionInformationFailureTransfer is made optional to align with tabular.
In DistributionSetupRequestIEs, DistributionSetupResponseIEs and DistributionSetupFailureIEs, the MBS-AreaSessionID is added to align with tabular.
In DistributionReleaseRequestIEs and DistributionReleaseResponseIEs, the MBS-AreaSessionID is added to align with tabular.
Some editorial corrections in ASN.1/tabular, e.g. aligning naming with typical NGAP conventions.

title: Rapporteur Rel-19 Corrections

consequencesIfNotApproved:
“traffic transfer over the inter-IAB-donor-DU tunnel” is misunderstanding.
The condition when the Traffic Required Modified List IE is included in the IAB TRANSPORT MIGRATION MODIFICATION RESPONSE message is incorrect. 
The purpose of the IAB Resource Coordination procedure is inaccurate. 
RB Set Configuration is not aligned with RAN1 agreements.
The description of RB Set Configuration IE is inaccurate. 
The IAB Transport Migration Management procedure cannot be rejected. 
Cannot support modifying the configuration for the migration of boundary and descendant nodes traffic between two IAB-donor-CUs
Unclear and incorrect specification text and ASN.1.
reasonForChange:
In section 8.5.2.2, it is stated “configure the related IAB-donor-DU to enable traffic transfer over the inter-IAB-donor-DU tunnel”, which is inaccurate. In our view, the inter-IAB-donor-DU tunnel can only be used for re-routing but not for the traffic transfer during inter-donor migration/redundancy/BH RLF recovery. So the “traffic transfer” here is misunderstanding and needs to be clarified. 
In section 8.5.3.2, it is stated “The F1-terminating IAB-donor responds with the IAB TRANSPORT MIGRATION MODIFICATION RESPONSE message, by indicating the already offloaded traffic accepted for modification, within the Traffic Required Modified List IE.” However, the the Traffic Required Modified List IE shall be included in the response message only if the Traffic Required To Be Modified List IE is contained in the request message. 
In section 8.5.4.1, it is stated “the purpose of the IAB Resource Coordination procedure is to exchange the semi-static radio resource configuration pertaining to a boundary IAB-node”. However, not only boundary node’s but also its parent node’s resource configuration could be exchanged via the IAB Resource Coordination procedure. 
As agreed in RAN1#108-e, the start RB index of the first RB set for the Rel-17 IAB-DU HSNA resource configuration is the lowest index of RB of the IAB-DU cell. So there is no need to configure initial RB index for each RB set any more. Instead, Number of RB Sets needs to be configured for a given gNB-DU cell. 
“up to M non-overlapping” should be clarified in the description of RB Set Configuration IE. 
maxnoofTLAsIAB is defined as “individual IPv4/IPv6 addresses or IPv6 address prefixes”. Instead, it is the total number of IPv4 address, IPv6 address and IPv6 address prefix.
In the clause 9.2.2.83, the IAB QoS Mapping Information is mandatory in the Non-F1-terminating Topology BH Information IE, but the DSCP and/or flow label may not need to be changed, when the non-F1 terminating donor want to modify the L2 information to the F1-terminating donor, then “optional” should be more appropriate for the IAB QoS Mapping Information IE. 
The description of the IAB QoS Mapping Information in 9.2.2.91 is “This IE indicates the DSCP and/or IPv6 Flow Label field(s) of IP packet which is sent through the GTP-U tunnel of a requested DRB.”  But such description is not applicable since the offloaded traffic is not given per GTP-U tunnel, and the offloaded traffic can be F1-C traffic also. 
The following IEs included the Multiplexing Info IE in 9.2.2.79 are not extendable: DU_RX/MT_RX, DU_TX/MT_TX, DU_TX/MT_RX, and DU_RX/MT_TX, and it is better to allow the extension of these IEs for future releases. 
In real case, the non-F1-terminating donor may reject the IAB Transport migration due to, e.g., load issue. Thus, the unsuccessful should be defined for such procedure. 
9.2.2.40 Intended TDD DL-UL Configuration NR, semantics desrciption is unclear.
The Assigned Criticality of IAB Node Indication IE in the tabular of S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST message is ignore, which is not aligned with the ASN.1 part. 
The Assigned Criticality of IAB TNL Address Exception IE in IAB TRANSPORT MIGRATION MANAGEMENT REQUEST message should be reject rather than ignore. If it’s ignore, an IAB-node cannot identify the UL packets for UL local-routing properly. Moreover, the Assigned Criticality of IAB TNL Address Exception IE in F1AP IAB TNL ADDRESS REQUEST message is reject. 
In IAB Transport Migration Modification procedure, only Traffic Index included in Traffic Required To Be Modified Item is meaningless for F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU to modify the configuration. Therefore, Non-F1-terminating topology BH information also need to be mandatary included in Traffic Required To Be Modified Item.
The abbreviation for “BH” is missing.
Numerous editorial changes and ASN.1 corrections are needed.
summaryOfChange:
Correct “traffic transfer” to “traffic re-routing”.
Correct that the the Traffic Required Modified List IE shall be included in the response message only if the Traffic Required To Be Modified List IE is contained in the request message.
Correct that not only boundary node’s but also its parent node’s resource configuration could be exchanged via the IAB Resource Coordination procedure.
Replace RB Set List IE with Number of RB Sets IE.
Clarify “up to M non-overlapping” in the description of RB Set Configuration IE.
Clarify the definition for maxnoofTLAsIAB. 
Change the presence of the IAB QoS Mapping Information IE to be mandatory in clause 9.2.2.83. 
And add procedure text for this IAB QoS Mapping Information IE in the clause 8.5.2.2 and 8.5.3.2. 
Modify the description of the IAB QoS Mapping Information IE in clause 9.2.2.91.
Change the following IEs included the Multiplexing Info IE in 9.2.2.79 to be extendable: DU_RX/MT_RX, DU_TX/MT_TX, DU_TX/MT_RX, and DU_RX/MT_TX.
Add unsuccessful operation for IAB Transport Migration Management procedure. 
Correction on 9.2.2.40 Intended TDD DL-UL Configuration NR:
Correct the Assigned Criticality of IAB Node Indication IE in the tabular of S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST message from ignore to reject.
Correct the Assigned Criticality of IAB TNL Address Exception IE in IAB TRANSPORT MIGRATION MANAGEMENT REQUEST message from ignore to reject in both tabular and ASN.1 part. 
Change the presence information of Non-F1-terminating topology BH information in Traffic Required To Be Modified Item.
Add the abbreviation for “BH” is missing.
Correct some editorial and ASN.1 errors. 

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the IAB related procedure.
